name: @forge/builder
description: FORGE Ecosystem Builder: Launch Blueprint schema, deterministic blueprint generator, playbooks, build stage pipeline and job handlers. Never launches anything.

scripts.blueprints: for nv in bidline:1.0.5 quilt-plan-kit:1.0.4 loaf-ledger:1.0.4 garden-planner:1.0.7; do n=${nv%%:*}; v=${nv##*:}; nb=; [ $n = garden-planner ] && nb=--new-business; node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --experimental-strip-types bin/blueprint.ts test/fixtures/$n.brief.json --registry ../../registry/products.json --version $v --supersedes-previous $nb || exit 1; done
scripts.kit:test: vitest run test/garden-ecosystem.test.ts -t 'Frost Date Garden Planner kit'
